articles.title: American Express Falls After Earnings. The Stock Is Having a Rocky Start to 2026.
articles.mainIdea: American Express Falls After Earnings. The Stock Is Having a Rocky Start to 2026.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: American Express Falls After Earnings. The Stock Is Having a Rocky Start to 2026.. Shares of American Express dropped Friday after the credit-card giant’s quarterly earnings slightly missed analysts’ estimates and its 2026 outlook met expectations. President Donald Trump’s call to cap credit-card interest rates at 10% for one year hasn’t helped, though that policy may have a more muted impact on American Express’ generally high-credit clientele. It forecast per-share earnings of $17.30 to $17.90 for the year, slightly higher at the midpoint than analysts’ estimate of $17.43.
